extensionDescription.message: Add transparent PNGs to the Bluesky web composer without flattening their alpha channel.

textDirection.description: Writing direction for this locale. Use 'ltr' or 'rtl'.

panelDocumentTitle.description: Document title for the compose panel.

popupDocumentTitle.description: Document title for the Firefox toolbar popup.

popupTitle.description: Heading in the Firefox toolbar popup.

notSignedIn.description: Account status when the extension has no Bluesky session.

blueskyHandle.description: Label and placeholder for the Bluesky account identifier.

blueskyAppPassword.description: Label and placeholder for a Bluesky app password.

appPasswordHelp.message: Use a Bluesky app password, not your account password. $LINK$.
appPasswordHelp.description: Complete app-password guidance with one placeholder for the real app-password-settings link; translator may reorder and punctuate.

postText.description: Label for the post text field.

postLength.description: Accessible name for the post-length progress indicator.

postTextPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the post text field.

postCharacterMaximum.description: Accessible description of Bluesky's 300-grapheme post limit.

addPng.description: Label for the native file picker control.

addPngHint.message: Paste PNGs, drop them anywhere in this dialog, or choose Add PNG.
addPngHint.description: Explains the supported ways to add PNG files.

newTransparentPngPost.description: Toolbar-popup button that starts a fresh transparent-PNG post.

addTransparentPngLauncher.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the PNG launcher injected into Bluesky's composer.

transparentPngTools.description: Title of the extension iframe inserted into Bluesky.

pngLimitReached.description: Visible and accessible status when all four PNG attachment slots are filled and native Add PNG input is disabled.

altCountStatusSeparator.description: Visible separator, including surrounding spacing, between the alt-text character count and status.

postTextExceedsCharacterMaximum.message: Post text exceeds the $MAXIMUM$ character maximum.
postTextExceedsCharacterMaximum.description: Validation error when post text is over the grapheme limit.

postTextExceedsSizeLimit.message: Post text exceeds Bluesky's text size limit.
postTextExceedsSizeLimit.description: Validation error when post text exceeds Bluesky's UTF-8 byte limit.

imagesAdded_one.description: Screen-reader confirmation after adding one PNG.

imagesAdded_other.message: Added $COUNT$ PNGs. Alt text required for each.
imagesAdded_other.description: Screen-reader confirmation after adding multiple PNGs.

imagesAddedColor_one.description: Screen-reader confirmation after adding one resized PNG with changed color information. Color note precedes the alt-text requirement.

imagesAddedColor_other.message: Added $COUNT$ PNGs. $COLORNOTE$ Alt text required for each.
imagesAddedColor_other.description: Screen-reader confirmation after adding multiple PNGs when one or more have changed color information. Color note precedes the alt-text requirement.

optimizedFileSize.description: Shows original and optimized image sizes.

colorMayChangeAfterResize.description: Quiet note in the image footer if color-signaling chunks changed during image resizing. This color warning follows the optimization message, which already explains the completed change; no separate live announcement.

imagePosition.description: Position of an image in the current post.

removeImageAccessibleLabel.description: Accessible label for an image Remove button.

removeImage.description: Tooltip for an image Remove button.

altTextForImage.description: Accessible label for an image alt-text field.

characterMaximum.description: Accessible description of a text-field character maximum.

altTextComplete.description: Status shown when an image has alt text.

altTextRequired.description: Status shown when an image still needs alt text.

couldNotOptimizeFile.message: Couldn't optimize $FILENAME$ below Bluesky's image limits.
couldNotOptimizeFile.description: Error after image optimization cannot reach Bluesky's limits.

sourcePngTooLarge.message: Can't process $FILENAME$: PNG source exceeds the 128 MB safety limit.
sourcePngTooLarge.description: Error before reading a PNG whose input file exceeds the source-memory budget. Large images within the budget may still be optimized.

sourcePngDimensionsTooLarge.message: Can't process $FILENAME$: image exceeds 64 megapixels or 16,384 pixels on a side.
sourcePngDimensionsTooLarge.description: Error before decoding a PNG whose IHDR dimensions exceed the decoded-image resource budget.

pleaseChoosePngFiles.description: Error when a selected file is not PNG.

notReadablePng.message: $FILENAME$ is not a readable PNG image.
notReadablePng.description: Error when a PNG cannot be decoded.

optimizingFile.description: Status while an oversized PNG is being optimized.

couldNotAddPng.description: Fallback error when adding a PNG fails.

enterCredentials.message: Enter your Bluesky handle and app password.
enterCredentials.description: Error when sign-in fields are incomplete.

uploadingImage.description: Status while images are uploaded sequentially.

publishing.description: Status while creating the Bluesky post.

publicationOutcomeUncertain.message: Bluesky may have published this post, but the extension could not confirm it. Check your Bluesky profile before trying Post again. Your PNG draft is preserved.
publicationOutcomeUncertain.description: Caution when a createRecord request was sent but the post outcome cannot be established; no automatic retry.

freshLaunchRecoveryFailedNotice.message: Transparent PNG Poster could not resume the new post after Bluesky sign-in. Use New transparent PNG post from the extension toolbar to try again.
freshLaunchRecoveryFailedNotice.description: Page notice when a signed-out toolbar launch cannot resume after Bluesky login.

toolbarLaunchWarningHeading.description: Heading of the keyboard-reachable notice after a failed toolbar new-post launch.

toolbarLaunchInterruptedNotice.message: Transparent PNG Poster could not open a new post. If you are signed out of the Bluesky website, sign in on this tab, then use New transparent PNG post from the Firefox toolbar again. The extension sign-in does not sign you in to the website.
toolbarLaunchInterruptedNotice.description: Fallback alert on a toolbar-created Bluesky tab if its launch could not complete, including across sign-in redirects.

freshLaunchFailedNotice.message: Transparent PNG Poster could not open Bluesky's composer. The extension sign-in is separate from the Bluesky website. If this tab is signed out of bsky.app, sign in here; the pending transparent-PNG post will resume automatically for up to five minutes.
freshLaunchFailedNotice.description: Page notice when the toolbar launch reaches a signed-out Bluesky page.

blueskyDidNotOpenComposer.message: Bluesky did not open a new-post composer.
blueskyDidNotOpenComposer.description: Internal launch error returned when Bluesky does not open a composer.

panelCouldNotOpen.message: The Transparent PNG panel could not be opened.
panelCouldNotOpen.description: Internal launch error returned when the extension panel cannot open.

firefoxDidNotReturnNewTab.message: Firefox did not return the new Bluesky tab.
firefoxDidNotReturnNewTab.description: Error when Firefox fails to return a newly created tab.

newBlueskyTabNotReady.message: The new Bluesky tab did not become ready for the extension.
newBlueskyTabNotReady.description: Error when a newly created Bluesky tab never becomes ready for messaging.

invalidRefreshedSession.message: Bluesky returned an invalid renewed session. Try again or sign in again.
invalidRefreshedSession.description: Shown when refreshSession returns incomplete credentials or a different account DID.

notSignedInError.description: Error when a signed-in AT Protocol session is required.

invalidCredentials.message: Check your Bluesky handle and app password, then try again.
invalidCredentials.description: Actionable error for sign-in rejected with HTTP 401.

signInRateLimited.message: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
signInRateLimited.description: Error when Bluesky limits the frequency of sign-in requests (HTTP 429).

signInUnavailable.message: Bluesky sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
signInUnavailable.description: Error when Bluesky's sign-in service returns a server failure (HTTP 5xx).

signInConnectionFailed.message: Couldn't connect to Bluesky. Check your connection and try again.
signInConnectionFailed.description: Error when Firefox could not reach Bluesky to sign in.

invalidPngUploadPayload.message: The PNG upload payload is invalid.
invalidPngUploadPayload.description: Error when the background uploader receives invalid PNG bytes.

pngLargerThanBlueskyLimit.message: The PNG is larger than Bluesky's 2 MB image limit.
pngLargerThanBlueskyLimit.description: Error when a PNG exceeds Bluesky's upload limit.

invalidPostText.description: Error when post text is not a string.

postTextLongerThanAllowed.message: The post text is longer than Bluesky allows.
postTextLongerThanAllowed.description: Backend validation error for post text over Bluesky's limits.

invalidImageAttachment.description: Backend validation error for malformed image data.

altTextLongerThanAllowed.message: Alt text must be 1,000 characters or fewer.
altTextLongerThanAllowed.description: Backend enforcement of the PNG composer 1,000-character Alt text limit.

everyImageNeedsAltText.description: Backend validation error when an image has no alt text.

invalidImageDimensions.description: Backend validation error for invalid image dimensions.

postMustContainOneToFourImages.message: A post must contain between one and four images.
postMustContainOneToFourImages.description: Backend validation error for image count.

invalidPostLanguages.message: The post language selection is invalid.
invalidPostLanguages.description: Error shown if internally supplied post-language metadata is malformed.

readBlueskyPage.description: Primary action of the split composer control. Minimizes the PNG composer while preserving its draft and allowing interaction with Bluesky.

minimizeComposerHelp.message: Minimize to read and interact with Bluesky
minimizeComposerHelp.description: Native title tooltip explaining the Minimize composer action.

returnToPngComposer.description: Floating page button to reopen the suspended PNG composer with its draft and attachments intact.

nativeComposerBlockedByAnother.message: Another Bluesky composer is open. Minimize this PNG composer, save or close the other composer, then return and try Cancel again. Your PNG draft is preserved.
nativeComposerBlockedByAnother.description: Cancel cannot restore this PNG draft while another native Bluesky composer is visible; explains how to recover without overwriting another draft.

nativeComposerRecoveryFailed.message: Couldn't restore your text to Bluesky. Your PNG draft is still here; you can try Cancel again or publish from this window.
nativeComposerRecoveryFailed.description: Shown when the original Bluesky composer was lost during page navigation and a fresh native composer cannot safely be restored.

posted.description: Brief confirmation after a successful post; the current Bluesky page stays open.

couldNotReadBlueskyPage.message: Couldn't close Bluesky's composer safely. Your PNG draft is still here.
couldNotReadBlueskyPage.description: Shown if the experimental Read Bluesky page action cannot dismiss its owned native composer.

moveComposer.description: Native disclosure that opens the optional nine-position placement picker.

composerPositions.description: Native group label for the nine move buttons.

moveTopLeft.description: Place the composer at the upper-left of the viewport.

moveTopCenter.description: Place the composer at the upper center of the viewport.

moveTopRight.description: Place the composer at the upper-right of the viewport.

moveMiddleLeft.description: Place the composer at the center-left of the viewport.

moveMiddleCenter.description: Center the composer in the available viewport.

moveMiddleRight.description: Place the composer at center-right of the viewport.

moveBottomLeft.description: Place the composer at the lower-left of the viewport.

moveBottomCenter.description: Place the composer at the lower center of the viewport.

moveBottomRight.description: Place the composer at the lower-right of the viewport.

postAnyway.description: Explicit confirmation to publish when some @mentions cannot be linked; same native Post button.

unresolvedMentionsWarning.message: Could not verify $HANDLES$. If you post anyway, these may appear as plain text without a clickable mention or notification. Correct the handle, or choose Post anyway.
unresolvedMentionsWarning.description: Shown before publishing when Bluesky mention handle lookups fail. No post has been created. Includes a comma-separated list of unresolved handles.

checkingMentions.description: Brief progress announcement while looking up account handles before publishing.

sessionExpiredSignInAgain.message: Your Bluesky session expired. Sign in again to continue.
sessionExpiredSignInAgain.description: Shown when the saved session refresh token has been rejected by Bluesky.

blueskyPageAccountUnavailable.message: Cannot verify the account signed into the Bluesky page. Sign in on bsky.app and try again; nothing was posted.
blueskyPageAccountUnavailable.description: Account identity could not be read from Bluesky's selected web session. Blocks publishing.

blueskyAccountMismatch.message: Account mismatch: the Bluesky page uses $PAGE$, but the PNG composer is signed in as $EXTENSION$. Sign in to the same account in both before posting. Nothing was posted.
blueskyAccountMismatch.description: The website and extension are signed into different DIDs. Two text-only display names; no tokens.

blueskyAccountChangedWhilePosting.message: The PNG composer's signed-in account changed during posting. Nothing was posted; check your account and try again.
blueskyAccountChangedWhilePosting.description: The background publisher refuses a DID different from the account verified on the Bluesky page.

checkingAccountsTitle.description: Displayed at the top while comparing the website and extension accounts.

checkingAccountsDescription.message: Checking that Bluesky and the PNG composer are signed into the same account…
checkingAccountsDescription.description: Shown briefly before users edit a draft.

accountsDoNotMatchTitle.description: Heading for the early account mismatch notice.

accountsDoNotMatchDescription.message: Bluesky is using $PAGE$, but the PNG composer is signed in as $EXTENSION$. Switch the PNG account here, or return to Bluesky to switch its account. Restore this composer and check again. The draft stays here while minimized, but a page reload can discard it.
accountsDoNotMatchDescription.description: Description above the editor of mismatched account DIDs.

cannotVerifyBlueskyAccountTitle.description: Heading when Bluesky page account cannot be confirmed.

cannotVerifyBlueskyAccountDescription.message: The Bluesky page account could not be verified. Check that you are signed in on bsky.app, then choose Check again. Posting is disabled until the accounts can be confirmed.
cannotVerifyBlueskyAccountDescription.description: Displayed if web identity cannot be verified.

switchPngAccount.description: Opens a provisional sign-in form; keeps the current extension account signed in until replacement credentials are accepted.

switchBlueskyAccount.description: Minimizes the PNG composer to reveal Bluesky's native account UI; does not switch accounts automatically.

checkAccountsAgain.description: Rechecks the current Bluesky website and PNG extension accounts.

recheckAccountsMatched.message: Check $ATTEMPT$ complete: accounts match. Posting is available.
recheckAccountsMatched.description: Confirmation after a manual account recheck succeeds.

recheckAccountsStillDifferent.message: Check $ATTEMPT$ complete: accounts still do not match. Posting remains disabled.
recheckAccountsStillDifferent.description: Confirmation after a manual account recheck detects the same mismatch.

recheckAccountsUnavailable.message: Check $ATTEMPT$ complete: could not verify the Bluesky account. Posting remains disabled.
recheckAccountsUnavailable.description: Confirmation after a manual account recheck cannot verify website identity.

accountSwitchHelp.message: Your current PNG account stays signed in until the new sign-in succeeds. Cancel to keep it.
accountSwitchHelp.description: Explains that opening the switch-account form does not sign out the existing account.

cancelAccountSwitch.description: Closes the provisional login form without signing out or discarding the PNG draft.

imagesAddedDetails_one.description: Single combined screen-reader confirmation when an attached image was optimized and may have a color warning; details precede the alt requirement.

details.example: Optimized from 37.16 MB to 1.37 MB. Colors may have changed.

imagesAddedDetails_other.message: Added $COUNT$ PNGs. $DETAILS$ Alt text required for each.
imagesAddedDetails_other.description: Single combined screen-reader confirmation for multiple PNGs with optimization and possibly a color warning.

details.example: 1 image resized and optimized. Colors may have changed.

imageOptimizedSizeSpeech.description: Succinct file-size change included once in the image-added screen-reader announcement for a single optimized PNG.

imagesOptimized_one.description: Announces a single optimized image as part of a multiple-image attachment confirmation.

imagesOptimized_other.description: Announces an optimized image count as part of a multiple-image attachment confirmation.

moveComposerShort.description: Compact visible label for the native positioning disclosure next to the drag handle; accessible label remains Move composer.

minimizeComposerShort.description: Compact visible label for the composer Minimize action; accessible label remains Minimize composer.

moveImageUp.description: Tooltip for the up-arrow attachment ordering button.

moveImageDown.description: Tooltip for the down-arrow attachment ordering button.

moveImageUpAccessibleLabel.description: Full accessible name for an image Move up button, announcing its current ordinal position and filename.

moveImageDownAccessibleLabel.description: Full accessible name for an image Move down button, announcing its current ordinal position and filename.
